name: ISL Online
summary: ISL Online sells cloud remote support and unattended access with a 15-day free trial. Its Starter, Standard and Premium cloud plans are priced in US dollars, billed annually. Premium adds single sign-on through SAML, and the Enterprise plan is sold by quote.

facts.text: The pricing page's feature comparison lists Remote support, Share my screen and Unattended access, and an Unattended Access Features section that includes Computer access history and Automatic session recording.

The comparison table lists AES 256-bit end-to-end encryption, two-factor authentication and an allow or deny list under Security. The page does not show which plan includes each item in the text we read.
Single sign-on is listed as Premium only, under Premium Services, and the Premium plan lists SSO/SAML.
The pricing page offers a free trial for 15 days covering 1 user and 5 managed devices, with no credit card needed. It also states a 15-day money-back guarantee on paid plans.
The page says prices are in USD and exclude tax.

plans.name: Starter
plans.unit: per user per month, billed annually
plans.notes: Billed at $202.80 a year. 1 licensed user and 10 managed devices. The page shows no SSO on this plan.

plans.name: Standard
plans.unit: per concurrent user per month, billed annually
plans.notes: Billed at $418.80 a year for the base option. The page offers a concurrent-user selector from 1 to 20+. Up to 40 licensed users and 1,000 managed devices. Standard customization is included.

plans.name: Premium
plans.unit: per concurrent user per month, billed annually
plans.notes: Billed at $658.80 a year for the base option. The page offers a concurrent-user selector from 1 to 20+. Unlimited users and devices, SSO/SAML and premium support.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: The page shows no price and says to contact us. It lists a private cloud and an account manager.

hiddenCosts: Standard and Premium prices shown are for one concurrent user. The page does not state the per-user price for larger concurrent counts.
The page says prices exclude tax.
